title: Quasiconformal deformations of chordal Loewner chains
summary: We establish first-order variational formulas for the driving function and the half-plane capacity of a chordal Loewner chain under quasiconformal deformations. Under the standard normalization fixing $0,1$ and $\infty$, the formulas hold for every bounded Beltrami differential. If the curve has positive area, the formulas contain additional integrals over the curve; these terms vanish when the curve has zero area or when the differential is extended by zero on the curve. The proof uses the normalized Ahlfors--Bers variation together with a Stoilow factorization adapted to the slit domain.…
